parameters.name: type
parameters.value: ={{    (function() {     const teks = $('WAHA Trigger').first().json.payload.body.toLowerCase();     if (teks.includes("berita")) {       return "news";     } else if (teks.includes("gambar") || teks.includes("foto")) {       return "images";     } else {       return "search";     }   })()  }}

parameters.command:
=FILE="/tmp/gembok_{{ $json.payload.from }}.txt"
NOW=$(date +%s)

if [ -f "$FILE" ]; then
    FILE_TIME=$(stat -c %Y "$FILE")
    DIFF=$((NOW - FILE_TIME))
    if [ $DIFF -gt 30 ]; then
        touch "$FILE"
        echo "LULUS"
    else
        echo "SPAM"
    fi
else
    touch "$FILE"
    echo "LULUS"
fi
